1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# loa-decisions-surface.sh: SessionStart hook that surfaces pending decision rows.
     4	#
     5	# Prints up to 10 `proposed` then `open` rows of grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml (id, status,
     6	# summary only) so the operator sees what awaits /decisions confirm. DEFAULT-OFF: gated on
     7	# `decisions.surface_at_session_start` (default false) in .loa.config.yaml.
     8	#
     9	# CONTRACT (observability, never a gate; same as loa-kf-surface.sh):
    10	#   - Exits 0 on every path and never blocks a session.
    11	#   - Disabled, no config, or no Mike Farah yq v4: prints nothing.
    12	#   - Enabled but the ledger is unreadable or has an unknown schema_version: one
    13	#     "[DECISIONS] WARNING ..." line on stdout.
    14	#   - Enabled and healthy: the block on stdout (SessionStart injects stdout as context);
    15	#     nothing when no row is open or proposed and no marker is stale.
    16	#   - A stale .run/unattended.json (another session, or older than
    17	#     decisions.unattended_marker_ttl_hours, default 24) adds one notice line.
    18	#
    19	# TRUST BOUNDARY: row text is agent-authored and UNTRUSTED. Only id, status and summary are
    20	#   read; each summary is control-stripped (C0, C1, U+2028/9), angle brackets are replaced so
    21	#   no tag can close the fence, and it is capped at 100 characters. The whole block is then
    22	#   wrapped by the L6 data fence, sanitize_for_session_start L6 <block> --max-chars 2000
    23	#   (context-isolation-lib.sh). Without that sanitizer the block is not printed.
    24	# =============================================================================
    25	set -uo pipefail
    26	
    27	HOOK_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    28	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "${HOOK_DIR}/../../.." && pwd)"
    29	
    30	# Test seam (mirrors loa-kf-surface.sh): overrides are honoured only under
    31	# LOA_DEC_SURFACE_TEST_MODE=1 with a bats marker present.
    32	_dec_test_mode_active() {
    33	  [[ "${LOA_DEC_SURFACE_TEST_MODE:-0}" == "1" ]] || return 1
    34	  [[ -n "${BATS_TEST_FILENAME:-}" || -n "${BATS_VERSION:-}" ]]
    35	}
    36	
    37	command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0
    38	[[ "$(yq --version 2>&1 || true)" == *mikefarah*"version v4."* ]] || exit 0
    39	command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0
    40	
    41	config_path="${REPO_ROOT}/.loa.config.yaml"
    42	enabled="false"
    43	if _dec_test_mode_active && [[ -n "${LOA_DEC_SURFACE_TEST_CONFIG-}" ]]; then
    44	  enabled="${LOA_DEC_SURFACE_TEST_CONFIG}"
    45	elif [[ -f "$config_path" ]]; then
    46	  enabled="$(yq '.decisions.surface_at_session_start // false' "$config_path" 2>/dev/null || echo false)"
    47	fi
    48	[[ "$enabled" == "true" ]] || exit 0
    49	
    50	LEDGER="${REPO_ROOT}/grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml"
    51	RUN_DIR="${REPO_ROOT}/.run"
    52	if _dec_test_mode_active; then
    53	  [[ -n "${LOA_DECISIONS_FILE:-}" ]] && LEDGER="${LOA_DECISIONS_FILE}"
    54	  [[ -n "${LOA_DEC_SURFACE_RUN_DIR:-}" ]] && RUN_DIR="${LOA_DEC_SURFACE_RUN_DIR}"
    55	fi
    56	
    57	if [[ ! -r "$LEDGER" ]]; then
    58	  echo "[DECISIONS] WARNING: the decision ledger is unreadable at grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml; the surface is enabled but degraded."
    59	  exit 0
    60	fi
    61	doc="$(yq -o=json -I0 '.' "$LEDGER" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    62	if [[ -z "$doc" ]] || ! printf '%s' "$doc" | jq -e '.schema_version == 1 and ((.decisions // []) | type == "array")' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    63	  echo "[DECISIONS] WARNING: grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml does not parse or has an unknown schema_version; the surface is enabled but degraded."
    64	  exit 0
    65	fi
    66	
    67	# Rows: proposed first, then open; fields reduced to a safe id, the status and a cleaned summary.
    68	rows="$(printf '%s' "$doc" | jq -r '
    69	  def clean: tostring | gsub("[[:cntrl:]\u0080-\u009f  ]"; " ") | gsub("<"; "‹") | gsub(">"; "›")
    70	             | gsub("`"; "‘") | gsub("  +"; " ") | sub("^ "; "") | sub(" $"; "");
    71	  def cap: if length > 100 then .[0:99] + "…" else . end;
    72	  [ (.decisions // [])[] | objects | select(.status == "proposed" or .status == "open") ]
    73	  | (map(select(.status == "proposed")) + map(select(.status == "open"))) as $r
    74	  | "C\t\($r | map(select(.status == "proposed")) | length)\t\($r | map(select(.status == "open")) | length)",
    75	    ($r[0:10][] | "R\t\((.id // "") | tostring | gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9-]"; "") | .[0:16])\t\(.status)\t\((.summary // "") | clean | cap)")
    76	' 2>/dev/null || true)"
    77	
    78	n_prop=0; n_open=0; lines=()
    79	while IFS=$'\t' read -r kind a b c; do
    80	  case "$kind" in
    81	    C) n_prop="$a"; n_open="$b" ;;
    82	    R) lines+=("- ${a} ${b}: ${c}") ;;
    83	  esac
    84	done <<< "$rows"
    85	
    86	# Stale unattended marker (the writer ignores it; the notice tells the operator to clear it).
    87	stale_note=""
    88	marker="${RUN_DIR}/unattended.json"
    89	if [[ -f "$marker" ]]; then
    90	  ttl="$(yq '.decisions.unattended_marker_ttl_hours // 24' "$config_path" 2>/dev/null || echo 24)"
    91	  [[ "$ttl" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$ttl" -gt 0 ]] || ttl=24
    92	  sid="$(jq -r '.session_id // empty' "$marker" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    93	  ca="$(jq -r '.created_at // empty' "$marker" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    94	  ep=""
    95	  if [[ -n "$ca" ]]; then
    96	    # shellcheck source=/dev/null
    97	    ep="$( (source "${REPO_ROOT}/.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1; _date_to_epoch "$ca") 2>/dev/null || true)"
    98	  fi
    99	  sess="${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:-${CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID:-}}"
   100	  if [[ ! "$ep" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || (( $(date -u +%s) - ep > ttl * 3600 )) || [[ -n "$sess" && -n "$sid" && "$sid" != "$sess" ]]; then
   101	    stale_note="[DECISIONS] .run/unattended.json is stale (other session or older than ${ttl} h): ignored; clear it with /decisions clear-unattended"
   102	  fi
   103	fi
   104	
   105	total=$(( n_prop + n_open ))
   106	[[ "$total" -gt 0 || -n "$stale_note" ]] || exit 0
   107	
   108	block="$(
   109	  if [[ "$total" -gt 0 ]]; then
   110	    echo "[DECISIONS] ${n_prop} proposed, ${n_open} open (grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml):"
   111	    printf '%s\n' "${lines[@]}"
   112	    if [[ "$total" -gt 10 ]]; then echo "... and $(( total - 10 )) more: dec-write-lib.sh list --status proposed,open"; fi
   113	  fi
   114	  [[ -z "$stale_note" ]] || echo "$stale_note"
   115	  if [[ "$n_prop" -gt 0 ]]; then echo "Confirm proposed rows with /decisions confirm."; fi
   116	)"
   117	
   118	fenced="$( (source "${REPO_ROOT}/.claude/scripts/lib/context-isolation-lib.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
   119	            && sanitize_for_session_start L6 "$block" --max-chars 2000) 2>/dev/null || true)"
   120	if [[ "$fenced" == *"<untrusted-content"* ]]; then
   121	  printf '%s\n' "$fenced"
   122	else
   123	  echo "[DECISIONS] WARNING: ${n_prop} proposed, ${n_open} open; the L6 sanitizer is unavailable, so rows are not shown. Run: .claude/scripts/lib/dec-write-lib.sh list --status proposed,open"
   124	fi
   125	exit 0
     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# tools/check-round-independence.sh: is an interview transcript asked in
     4	# prerequisite-ordered rounds?
     5	#
     6	# In `interview.pacing: rounds` every round of questions ends with one comment
     7	# block (discovering-requirements/resources/REFERENCE.md §Question Pacing):
     8	#
     9	#   <!-- round: 2; questions: [{"id":"Q4","depends_on":[]},{"id":"Q2","depends_on":[],"reasked":true}] -->
    10	#
    11	# This checker reads those blocks from a transcript (markdown or plain text,
    12	# one block per line) and fails when:
    13	#   * a `depends_on` names a question asked in the same round,
    14	#   * a `depends_on` names a question not asked in an earlier round,
    15	#   * a non-reasked id repeats, or a `reasked` id was never asked before,
    16	#   * round numbers do not increase, or a block is malformed,
    17	#   * the rounds average fewer than --min-average new questions (default 2).
    18	# `reasked` entries are skipped for id uniqueness and for the average. The
    19	# final round is exempt from the average when there are two or more rounds.
    20	#
    21	# Usage:
    22	#   tools/check-round-independence.sh <transcript> [--min-average N] [--json]
    23	#
    24	# Exit codes: 0 independent · 1 violation · 2 usage, unreadable file, or no
    25	#             round block in the transcript
    26	# =============================================================================
    27	set -euo pipefail
    28	export LC_ALL=C
    29	
    30	usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# Exit codes/p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
    31	
    32	TRANSCRIPT=""
    33	MIN_AVG="2"
    34	JSON=0
    35	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    36	  case "$1" in
    37	    --min-average)
    38	      [[ $# -ge 2 ]] || { echo "check-round-independence.sh: --min-average needs a number" >&2; exit 2; }
    39	      MIN_AVG="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    40	    --json) JSON=1; shift ;;
    41	    --help|-h) usage; exit 0 ;;
    42	    --) shift; [[ $# -ge 1 ]] && { TRANSCRIPT="$1"; shift; } ;;
    43	    -*) echo "check-round-independence.sh: unknown flag $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
    44	    *)
    45	      [[ -z "$TRANSCRIPT" ]] || { echo "check-round-independence.sh: one transcript only" >&2; exit 2; }
    46	      TRANSCRIPT="$1"; shift ;;
    47	  esac
    48	done
    49	
    50	[[ -n "$TRANSCRIPT" ]] || { echo "check-round-independence.sh: transcript path required" >&2; usage >&2; exit 2; }
    51	[[ -f "$TRANSCRIPT" && -r "$TRANSCRIPT" ]] || { echo "check-round-independence.sh: cannot read $TRANSCRIPT" >&2; exit 2; }
    52	[[ "$MIN_AVG" =~ ^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$ ]] || { echo "check-round-independence.sh: --min-average must be a non-negative number, got '$MIN_AVG'" >&2; exit 2; }
    53	command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "check-round-independence.sh: jq is required" >&2; exit 2; }
    54	
    55	BLOCK_RE='<!--[[:space:]]*round:[[:space:]]*[0-9]+[[:space:]]*;[[:space:]]*questions:[[:space:]]*\[.*\][[:space:]]*-->'
    56	
    57	# One JSON object per block: {round, questions} or {round, malformed}. grep exits
    58	# 1 on no match, which is the "no block" case below, not an error.
    59	blocks="$(grep -oE "$BLOCK_RE" "$TRANSCRIPT" || true)"
    60	if [[ -z "$blocks" ]]; then
    61	  echo "check-round-independence.sh: no <!-- round: N; questions: [...] --> block in $TRANSCRIPT" >&2
    62	  exit 2
    63	fi
    64	
    65	rounds_json="[]"
    66	while IFS= read -r block; do
    67	  [[ -n "$block" ]] || continue
    68	  n="$(printf '%s\n' "$block" | sed -E 's/^<!--[[:space:]]*round:[[:space:]]*([0-9]+).*/\1/')"
    69	  [[ ${#n} -le 9 ]] || { echo "check-round-independence.sh: round number $n is too long" >&2; exit 1; }
    70	  n=$((10#$n))   # "02" is not valid JSON; the round number is decimal
    71	  arr="$(printf '%s\n' "$block" | sed -E 's/^<!--[[:space:]]*round:[[:space:]]*[0-9]+[[:space:]]*;[[:space:]]*questions:[[:space:]]*//; s/[[:space:]]*-->$//')"
    72	  if printf '%s' "$arr" | jq -e 'type == "array" and all(.[];
    73	        type == "object" and (.id | type == "string" and length > 0)
    74	        and (.depends_on | type == "array" and all(.[]; type == "string")))' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    75	    entry="$(jq -cn --argjson r "$n" --argjson q "$arr" '{round: $r, questions: $q}')"
    76	  else
    77	    entry="$(jq -cn --argjson r "$n" --arg raw "$arr" '{round: $r, malformed: $raw}')"
    78	  fi
    79	  rounds_json="$(jq -cn --argjson a "$rounds_json" --argjson e "$entry" '$a + [$e]')"
    80	done <<< "$blocks"
    81	
    82	report="$(jq -n --argjson rounds "$rounds_json" --argjson min "$MIN_AVG" '
    83	  reduce range(0; $rounds | length) as $i (
    84	    {asked: [], violations: [], per_round: [], prev: null};
    85	    $rounds[$i] as $r
    86	    | (if .prev != null and $r.round <= .prev
    87	         then .violations += ["round \($r.round) does not follow round \(.prev)"] else . end)
    88	    | .prev = $r.round
    89	    | if $r.malformed != null then
    90	        .violations += ["round \($r.round): malformed questions array (each entry needs a string id and a depends_on array of strings)"]
    91	        | .per_round += [{round: $r.round, new: 0, reasked: 0, ids: []}]
    92	      else
    93	        ($r.questions | map(.id)) as $here
    94	        | .asked as $before
    95	        | reduce $r.questions[] as $q (.;
    96	            ($q.reasked == true) as $re
    97	            | (if $re then
    98	                 (if ($before | index([$q.id])) == null
    99	                    then .violations += ["round \($r.round): \($q.id) is marked reasked but was not asked in an earlier round"] else . end)
   100	               else
   101	                 (if (.asked | index([$q.id])) != null
   102	                    then .violations += ["round \($r.round): \($q.id) is asked again without \"reasked\": true"] else . end)
   103	                 | .asked += [$q.id]
   104	               end)
   105	            | reduce $q.depends_on[] as $d (.;
   106	                if ($here | index([$d])) != null and $d != $q.id then
   107	                  .violations += ["round \($r.round): \($q.id) depends on \($d), asked in the same round"]
   108	                elif $d == $q.id then
   109	                  .violations += ["round \($r.round): \($q.id) depends on itself"]
   110	                elif ($before | index([$d])) == null then
   111	                  .violations += ["round \($r.round): \($q.id) depends on \($d), not asked in an earlier round"]
   112	                else . end))
   113	        | .per_round += [{
   114	            round: $r.round,
   115	            new: ($r.questions | map(select(.reasked != true)) | length),
   116	            reasked: ($r.questions | map(select(.reasked == true)) | length),
   117	            ids: $here }]
   118	      end)
   119	  | .counted = (if (.per_round | length) >= 2 then .per_round[0:-1] else .per_round end)
   120	  | .average = (if (.counted | length) == 0 then 0
   121	                else ((.counted | map(.new) | add) / (.counted | length)) end)
   122	  | (if .average < $min
   123	       then .violations += ["average \(.average * 100 | round / 100) new questions per round is below --min-average \($min)"] else . end)
   124	  | {
   125	      rounds: (.per_round | length),
   126	      questions: (.per_round | map(.new) | add),
   127	      reasked: (.per_round | map(.reasked) | add),
   128	      average: (.average * 100 | round / 100),
   129	      min_average: $min,
   130	      final_round_exempt: ((.per_round | length) >= 2),
   131	      per_round: .per_round,
   132	      violations: .violations,
   133	      verdict: (if (.violations | length) == 0 then "PASS" else "FAIL" end)
   134	    }')"
   135	
   136	if [[ "$JSON" -eq 1 ]]; then
   137	  printf '%s\n' "$report"
   138	else
   139	  printf '%s\n' "$report" | jq -r '
   140	    (.per_round[] | "round \(.round): \(.new) new question(s)\(if .reasked > 0 then ", \(.reasked) re-asked" else "" end) [\(.ids | join(" "))]"),
   141	    "rounds: \(.rounds); questions: \(.questions); average: \(.average) per round\(if .final_round_exempt then " (final round exempt)" else "" end); min-average: \(.min_average)",
   142	    (.violations[] | "VIOLATION: \(.)"),
   143	    .verdict'
   144	fi
   145	
   146	verdict="$(printf '%s\n' "$report" | jq -r '.verdict')"
   147	[[ "$verdict" == "PASS" ]]

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# loa-decisions-surface.sh: SessionStart hook that surfaces pending decision rows.
     4	#
     5	# Prints up to 10 `proposed` then `open` rows of grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml (id, status,
     6	# summary only) so the operator sees what awaits /decisions confirm. DEFAULT-OFF: gated on
     7	# `decisions.surface_at_session_start` (default false) in .loa.config.yaml.
     8	#
     9	# CONTRACT (observability, never a gate; same as loa-kf-surface.sh):
    10	#   - Exits 0 on every path and never blocks a session.
    11	#   - Disabled, no config, or no Mike Farah yq v4: prints nothing.
    12	#   - Enabled but the ledger is unreadable or has an unknown schema_version: one
    13	#     "[DECISIONS] WARNING ..." line on stdout.
    14	#   - Enabled and healthy: the block on stdout (SessionStart injects stdout as context);
    15	#     nothing when no row is open or proposed and no marker is stale.
    16	#   - A stale .run/unattended.json (another session, or older than
    17	#     decisions.unattended_marker_ttl_hours, default 24) adds one notice line.
    18	#
    19	# TRUST BOUNDARY: row text is agent-authored and UNTRUSTED. Only id, status and summary are
    20	#   read; each summary is control-stripped (C0, C1, U+2028/9), angle brackets are replaced so
    21	#   no tag can close the fence, and it is capped at 100 characters. The whole block is then
    22	#   wrapped by the L6 data fence, sanitize_for_session_start L6 <block> --max-chars 2000
    23	#   (context-isolation-lib.sh). Without that sanitizer the block is not printed.
    24	# =============================================================================
    25	set -uo pipefail
    26	
    27	HOOK_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    28	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "${HOOK_DIR}/../../.." && pwd)"
    29	
    30	# Test seam (mirrors loa-kf-surface.sh): overrides are honoured only under
    31	# LOA_DEC_SURFACE_TEST_MODE=1 with a bats marker present.
    32	_dec_test_mode_active() {
    33	  [[ "${LOA_DEC_SURFACE_TEST_MODE:-0}" == "1" ]] || return 1
    34	  [[ -n "${BATS_TEST_FILENAME:-}" || -n "${BATS_VERSION:-}" ]]
    35	}
    36	
    37	command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0
    38	[[ "$(yq --version 2>&1 || true)" == *mikefarah*"version v4."* ]] || exit 0
    39	command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0
    40	
    41	config_path="${REPO_ROOT}/.loa.config.yaml"
    42	enabled="false"
    43	if _dec_test_mode_active && [[ -n "${LOA_DEC_SURFACE_TEST_CONFIG-}" ]]; then
    44	  enabled="${LOA_DEC_SURFACE_TEST_CONFIG}"
    45	elif [[ -f "$config_path" ]]; then
    46	  enabled="$(yq '.decisions.surface_at_session_start // false' "$config_path" 2>/dev/null || echo false)"
    47	fi
    48	[[ "$enabled" == "true" ]] || exit 0
    49	
    50	LEDGER="${REPO_ROOT}/grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml"
    51	RUN_DIR="${REPO_ROOT}/.run"
    52	if _dec_test_mode_active; then
    53	  [[ -n "${LOA_DECISIONS_FILE:-}" ]] && LEDGER="${LOA_DECISIONS_FILE}"
    54	  [[ -n "${LOA_DEC_SURFACE_RUN_DIR:-}" ]] && RUN_DIR="${LOA_DEC_SURFACE_RUN_DIR}"
    55	fi
    56	
    57	if [[ ! -r "$LEDGER" ]]; then
    58	  echo "[DECISIONS] WARNING: the decision ledger is unreadable at grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml; the surface is enabled but degraded."
    59	  exit 0
    60	fi
    61	doc="$(yq -o=json -I0 '.' "$LEDGER" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    62	if [[ -z "$doc" ]] || ! printf '%s' "$doc" | jq -e '.schema_version == 1 and ((.decisions // []) | type == "array")' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    63	  echo "[DECISIONS] WARNING: grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml does not parse or has an unknown schema_version; the surface is enabled but degraded."
    64	  exit 0
    65	fi
    66	
    67	# Rows: proposed first, then open; fields reduced to a safe id, the status and a cleaned summary.
    68	rows="$(printf '%s' "$doc" | jq -r '
    69	  def clean: tostring | gsub("[[:cntrl:]\u0080-\u009f  ]"; " ") | gsub("<"; "‹") | gsub(">"; "›")
    70	             | gsub("`"; "‘") | gsub("  +"; " ") | sub("^ "; "") | sub(" $"; "");
    71	  def cap: if length > 100 then .[0:99] + "…" else . end;
    72	  [ (.decisions // [])[] | objects | select(.status == "proposed" or .status == "open") ]
    73	  | (map(select(.status == "proposed")) + map(select(.status == "open"))) as $r
    74	  | "C\t\($r | map(select(.status == "proposed")) | length)\t\($r | map(select(.status == "open")) | length)",
    75	    ($r[0:10][] | "R\t\((.id // "") | tostring | gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9-]"; "") | .[0:16])\t\(.status)\t\((.summary // "") | clean | cap)")
    76	' 2>/dev/null || true)"
    77	
    78	n_prop=0; n_open=0; lines=()
    79	while IFS=$'\t' read -r kind a b c; do
    80	  case "$kind" in
    81	    C) n_prop="$a"; n_open="$b" ;;
    82	    R) lines+=("- ${a} ${b}: ${c}") ;;
    83	  esac
    84	done <<< "$rows"
    85	
    86	# Stale unattended marker (the writer ignores it; the notice tells the operator to clear it).
    87	stale_note=""
    88	marker="${RUN_DIR}/unattended.json"
    89	if [[ -f "$marker" ]]; then
    90	  ttl="$(yq '.decisions.unattended_marker_ttl_hours // 24' "$config_path" 2>/dev/null || echo 24)"
    91	  [[ "$ttl" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$ttl" -gt 0 ]] || ttl=24
    92	  sid="$(jq -r '.session_id // empty' "$marker" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    93	  ca="$(jq -r '.created_at // empty' "$marker" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    94	  ep=""
    95	  if [[ -n "$ca" ]]; then
    96	    # shellcheck source=/dev/null
    97	    ep="$( (source "${REPO_ROOT}/.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1; _date_to_epoch "$ca") 2>/dev/null || true)"
    98	  fi
    99	  sess="${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:-${CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID:-}}"
   100	  if [[ ! "$ep" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || (( $(date -u +%s) - ep > ttl * 3600 )) || [[ -n "$sess" && -n "$sid" && "$sid" != "$sess" ]]; then
   101	    stale_note="[DECISIONS] .run/unattended.json is stale (other session or older than ${ttl} h): ignored; clear it with /decisions clear-unattended"
   102	  fi
   103	fi
   104	
   105	total=$(( n_prop + n_open ))
   106	[[ "$total" -gt 0 || -n "$stale_note" ]] || exit 0
   107	
   108	block="$(
   109	  if [[ "$total" -gt 0 ]]; then
   110	    echo "[DECISIONS] ${n_prop} proposed, ${n_open} open (grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml):"
   111	    printf '%s\n' "${lines[@]}"
   112	    if [[ "$total" -gt 10 ]]; then echo "... and $(( total - 10 )) more: dec-write-lib.sh list --status proposed,open"; fi
   113	  fi
   114	  [[ -z "$stale_note" ]] || echo "$stale_note"
   115	  if [[ "$n_prop" -gt 0 ]]; then echo "Confirm proposed rows with /decisions confirm."; fi
   116	)"
   117	
   118	fenced="$( (source "${REPO_ROOT}/.claude/scripts/lib/context-isolation-lib.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
   119	            && sanitize_for_session_start L6 "$block" --max-chars 2000) 2>/dev/null || true)"
   120	if [[ "$fenced" == *"<untrusted-content"* ]]; then
   121	  printf '%s\n' "$fenced"
   122	else
   123	  echo "[DECISIONS] WARNING: ${n_prop} proposed, ${n_open} open; the L6 sanitizer is unavailable, so rows are not shown. Run: .claude/scripts/lib/dec-write-lib.sh list --status proposed,open"
   124	fi
   125	exit 0
     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# tools/check-round-independence.sh: is an interview transcript asked in
     4	# prerequisite-ordered rounds?
     5	#
     6	# In `interview.pacing: rounds` every round of questions ends with one comment
     7	# block (discovering-requirements/resources/REFERENCE.md §Question Pacing):
     8	#
     9	#   <!-- round: 2; questions: [{"id":"Q4","depends_on":[]},{"id":"Q2","depends_on":[],"reasked":true}] -->
    10	#
    11	# This checker reads those blocks from a transcript (markdown or plain text,
    12	# one block per line) and fails when:
    13	#   * a `depends_on` names a question asked in the same round,
    14	#   * a `depends_on` names a question not asked in an earlier round,
    15	#   * a non-reasked id repeats, or a `reasked` id was never asked before,
    16	#   * round numbers do not increase, or a block is malformed,
    17	#   * the rounds average fewer than --min-average new questions (default 2).
    18	# `reasked` entries are skipped for id uniqueness and for the average. The
    19	# final round is exempt from the average when there are two or more rounds.
    20	#
    21	# Usage:
    22	#   tools/check-round-independence.sh <transcript> [--min-average N] [--json]
    23	#
    24	# Exit codes: 0 independent · 1 violation · 2 usage, unreadable file, or no
    25	#             round block in the transcript
    26	# =============================================================================
    27	set -euo pipefail
    28	export LC_ALL=C
    29	
    30	usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# Exit codes/p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
    31	
    32	TRANSCRIPT=""
    33	MIN_AVG="2"
    34	JSON=0
    35	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    36	  case "$1" in
    37	    --min-average)
    38	      [[ $# -ge 2 ]] || { echo "check-round-independence.sh: --min-average needs a number" >&2; exit 2; }
    39	      MIN_AVG="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    40	    --json) JSON=1; shift ;;
    41	    --help|-h) usage; exit 0 ;;
    42	    --) shift; [[ $# -ge 1 ]] && { TRANSCRIPT="$1"; shift; } ;;
    43	    -*) echo "check-round-independence.sh: unknown flag $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
    44	    *)
    45	      [[ -z "$TRANSCRIPT" ]] || { echo "check-round-independence.sh: one transcript only" >&2; exit 2; }
    46	      TRANSCRIPT="$1"; shift ;;
    47	  esac
    48	done
    49	
    50	[[ -n "$TRANSCRIPT" ]] || { echo "check-round-independence.sh: transcript path required" >&2; usage >&2; exit 2; }
    51	[[ -f "$TRANSCRIPT" && -r "$TRANSCRIPT" ]] || { echo "check-round-independence.sh: cannot read $TRANSCRIPT" >&2; exit 2; }
    52	[[ "$MIN_AVG" =~ ^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$ ]] || { echo "check-round-independence.sh: --min-average must be a non-negative number, got '$MIN_AVG'" >&2; exit 2; }
    53	command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "check-round-independence.sh: jq is required" >&2; exit 2; }
    54	
    55	BLOCK_RE='<!--[[:space:]]*round:[[:space:]]*[0-9]+[[:space:]]*;[[:space:]]*questions:[[:space:]]*\[.*\][[:space:]]*-->'
    56	
    57	# One JSON object per block: {round, questions} or {round, malformed}. grep exits
    58	# 1 on no match, which is the "no block" case below, not an error.
    59	blocks="$(grep -oE "$BLOCK_RE" "$TRANSCRIPT" || true)"
    60	if [[ -z "$blocks" ]]; then
    61	  echo "check-round-independence.sh: no <!-- round: N; questions: [...] --> block in $TRANSCRIPT" >&2
    62	  exit 2
    63	fi
    64	
    65	rounds_json="[]"
    66	while IFS= read -r block; do
    67	  [[ -n "$block" ]] || continue
    68	  n="$(printf '%s\n' "$block" | sed -E 's/^<!--[[:space:]]*round:[[:space:]]*([0-9]+).*/\1/')"
    69	  [[ ${#n} -le 9 ]] || { echo "check-round-independence.sh: round number $n is too long" >&2; exit 1; }
    70	  n=$((10#$n))   # "02" is not valid JSON; the round number is decimal
    71	  arr="$(printf '%s\n' "$block" | sed -E 's/^<!--[[:space:]]*round:[[:space:]]*[0-9]+[[:space:]]*;[[:space:]]*questions:[[:space:]]*//; s/[[:space:]]*-->$//')"
    72	  if printf '%s' "$arr" | jq -e 'type == "array" and all(.[];
    73	        type == "object" and (.id | type == "string" and length > 0)
    74	        and (.depends_on | type == "array" and all(.[]; type == "string")))' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    75	    entry="$(jq -cn --argjson r "$n" --argjson q "$arr" '{round: $r, questions: $q}')"
    76	  else
    77	    entry="$(jq -cn --argjson r "$n" --arg raw "$arr" '{round: $r, malformed: $raw}')"
    78	  fi
    79	  rounds_json="$(jq -cn --argjson a "$rounds_json" --argjson e "$entry" '$a + [$e]')"
    80	done <<< "$blocks"
    81	
    82	report="$(jq -n --argjson rounds "$rounds_json" --argjson min "$MIN_AVG" '
    83	  reduce range(0; $rounds | length) as $i (
    84	    {asked: [], violations: [], per_round: [], prev: null};
    85	    $rounds[$i] as $r
    86	    | (if .prev != null and $r.round <= .prev
    87	         then .violations += ["round \($r.round) does not follow round \(.prev)"] else . end)
    88	    | .prev = $r.round
    89	    | if $r.malformed != null then
    90	        .violations += ["round \($r.round): malformed questions array (each entry needs a string id and a depends_on array of strings)"]
    91	        | .per_round += [{round: $r.round, new: 0, reasked: 0, ids: []}]
    92	      else
    93	        ($r.questions | map(.id)) as $here
    94	        | .asked as $before
    95	        | reduce $r.questions[] as $q (.;
    96	            ($q.reasked == true) as $re
    97	            | (if $re then
    98	                 (if ($before | index([$q.id])) == null
    99	                    then .violations += ["round \($r.round): \($q.id) is marked reasked but was not asked in an earlier round"] else . end)
   100	               else
   101	                 (if (.asked | index([$q.id])) != null
   102	                    then .violations += ["round \($r.round): \($q.id) is asked again without \"reasked\": true"] else . end)
   103	                 | .asked += [$q.id]
   104	               end)
   105	            | reduce $q.depends_on[] as $d (.;
   106	                if ($here | index([$d])) != null and $d != $q.id then
   107	                  .violations += ["round \($r.round): \($q.id) depends on \($d), asked in the same round"]
   108	                elif $d == $q.id then
   109	                  .violations += ["round \($r.round): \($q.id) depends on itself"]
   110	                elif ($before | index([$d])) == null then
   111	                  .violations += ["round \($r.round): \($q.id) depends on \($d), not asked in an earlier round"]
   112	                else . end))
   113	        | .per_round += [{
   114	            round: $r.round,
   115	            new: ($r.questions | map(select(.reasked != true)) | length),
   116	            reasked: ($r.questions | map(select(.reasked == true)) | length),
   117	            ids: $here }]
   118	      end)
   119	  | .counted = (if (.per_round | length) >= 2 then .per_round[0:-1] else .per_round end)
   120	  | .average = (if (.counted | length) == 0 then 0
   121	                else ((.counted | map(.new) | add) / (.counted | length)) end)
   122	  | (if .average < $min
   123	       then .violations += ["average \(.average * 100 | round / 100) new questions per round is below --min-average \($min)"] else . end)
   124	  | {
   125	      rounds: (.per_round | length),
   126	      questions: (.per_round | map(.new) | add),
   127	      reasked: (.per_round | map(.reasked) | add),
   128	      average: (.average * 100 | round / 100),
   129	      min_average: $min,
   130	      final_round_exempt: ((.per_round | length) >= 2),
   131	      per_round: .per_round,
   132	      violations: .violations,
   133	      verdict: (if (.violations | length) == 0 then "PASS" else "FAIL" end)
   134	    }')"
   135	
   136	if [[ "$JSON" -eq 1 ]]; then
   137	  printf '%s\n' "$report"
   138	else
   139	  printf '%s\n' "$report" | jq -r '
   140	    (.per_round[] | "round \(.round): \(.new) new question(s)\(if .reasked > 0 then ", \(.reasked) re-asked" else "" end) [\(.ids | join(" "))]"),
   141	    "rounds: \(.rounds); questions: \(.questions); average: \(.average) per round\(if .final_round_exempt then " (final round exempt)" else "" end); min-average: \(.min_average)",
   142	    (.violations[] | "VIOLATION: \(.)"),
   143	    .verdict'
   144	fi
   145	
   146	verdict="$(printf '%s\n' "$report" | jq -r '.verdict')"
   147	[[ "$verdict" == "PASS" ]]

commands.name: deep-research
commands.description: Deep research harness — fan-out web searches, fetch sources, adversarially verify claims, synthesize a cited report. (dynamic workflow)

commands.name: dataviz
commands.description: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. When the destination is a first-party document connector (host-designated, never self-described) that renders live charts, hand it the rows (inline, or as an uploaded data file the chart cites) rather than a rendered PNG/SVG — a picture of a chart loses hover, data inspection and per-value comments. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".

commands.name: update-config
commands.description: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Verify that a code change actually does what it's supposed to by exercising it end-to-end and observing behavior — drive the affected flow, not just tests or typecheck. Run before committing nontrivial changes; bootstraps this repo's project verify skill if none exists yet. Don't invoke it on a diff that only touches tests, docs, or other code with no runtime surface to drive (a change to product source always has one) — there's nothing to observe.

commands.name: debug
commands.description: Enable debug logging for this session and help diagnose issues

commands.name: code-review
commands.description: Review the current diff, or a PR number/branch/path target, for correctness bugs (plus reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups where the model's review recipe covers them) at the given effort level (low|medium|high|xhigh|max: from few high-confidence findings up to many, some of them uncertain); with no level given, it reuses the level you typed last. Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review. Pass --max-findings <n> to report up to n findings, or --max-findings all for every finding. The choice stays until you pass --max-findings default.

commands.name: simplify
commands.description: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.

commands.name: batch
commands.description: Research and plan a large-scale change, then execute it in parallel across 5–30 isolated worktree agents that each open a PR.

commands.name: fewer-permission-prompts
commands.description: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Health-check the user's Claude Code setup and fix issues: diagnose installation health — what the `claude doctor` terminal diagnostics cover — from local data (duplicate or leftover installs, PATH, unparseable settings files, broken or colliding agent definitions, skills whose frontmatter fails to parse); find unused skills, MCP servers, and plugins versus their context cost and disable dead weight; deduplicate local CLAUDE.md files against checked-in ones; trim checked-in CLAUDE.md files by cutting content a session could derive from the codebase (directory layouts, tech-stack lists, architecture overviews) while keeping gotchas, rationale, and non-standard conventions; migrate always-loaded CLAUDE.md guidance into lazy skills and nested CLAUDE.md files; flag slow hooks and context-heavy extensions; check the installed version is current; make auto mode the default permission mode; and pre-approve frequently denied read-only commands. Use when the user asks for a doctor run, checkup, audit, tune-up, or cleanup of their Claude Code setup or configuration.

commands.name: loop
commands.description: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace.

commands.name: claude-api
commands.description:
Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).

commands.name: workflow-authoring
commands.description: Reference for writing a Workflow tool script (script API and gotchas, resume, quality patterns, worked examples). Load before authoring a script for a workflow the user already opted into; it does not itself authorize running one.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).

commands.name: run-skill-generator
commands.description: Author or improve the run-<unit> skill - a per-project skill that tells agents how to build, launch, and drive this project's app. Use when the user asks to set up the project, get it running, write run instructions, or verify build/run steps work from a clean environment.

commands.name: plugin-authoring
commands.description: Make a mod: a change to Claude's own interface or behaviour, such as a live pane or panel, a band above the prompt, a status line, a toast, a slash command, or a hook on tool calls or prompts. Use to make, change or debug a mod or its hooks module.

commands.name: autonomous

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# =============================================================================
3	# dec-write-lib.sh: the single writer of the decision ledger grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml
4	#
5	# Rows are append-only (schema: grimoires/loa/sdd.md §3.1, docs/architecture/decision-lineage.md).
6	# Every write takes the lock, copies the ledger to a temp file beside it, applies the change with
7	# yq v4 (values reach yq only through env(); rows are built by jq --arg), VERIFIES the temp (it
8	# parses, no id dropped or repeated, the row count moves by exactly the operation's rows, every
9	# other row JSON-equal, and validate-artifact.sh --type decisions --base-file <current> passes),
10	# then renames it over the ledger. Any failure deletes the temp and leaves the ledger untouched.
11	#
12	# Attribution is derived, never passed: no caller sets decided_by. Skills write `open` or
13	# `proposed` rows with proposed_by agent (flatline|dissent only interactively, with an existing
14	# artifact whose sha256 is recorded). In an unattended context (`context` below) every write lands
15	# `proposed` (an explicit --status open stays open: an open question, not a decision taken),
16	# proposed_by is agent, and --answer-ref / --as are ignored with a WARN. Only the operator-only
17	# /decisions command passes --recorded-by decisions-command, the one caller of `confirm`, of
18	# `reject`/`supersede` on a decided row and of `context --clear`.
19	#
20	# A linked worktree (git-common-dir differs from git-dir) or --pending writes
21	# grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-<N>/decisions-pending.yaml with PEND-<8 hex> ids; `import` in the
22	# main checkout allocates the real DEC ids. Live-ledger writes exit 1 under CI, GITHUB_ACTIONS
23	# or LOA_HOOK_CONTEXT=1 (--file fixtures are exempt so the suites run in CI).
24	#
25	# Ops:
26	#   new        --summary S --phase P --category C --recorded-by R --source SRC
27	#              [--status open|proposed] [--decision D --rationale W --alternative-json J ...]
28	#              [--consequence-pos X ...] [--consequence-neg X ...] [--answer-ref REF]
29	#              [--as flatline|dissent] [--cycle C] [--evidence E] [--pending] [--sprint N]
30	#   decide     --id ID --decision D --rationale W --alternative-json J ... --evidence E --recorded-by R
31	#              [--answer-ref REF] [--consequence-pos X ...] [--consequence-neg X ...]
32	#   confirm    --recorded-by decisions-command --evidence E (--id ID ... | --cycle C [--all])
33	#              [--answer-ref REF]                                   (/decisions only)
34	#   reject     --id ID --rationale W --follow-up F --recorded-by R [--prior-request X ...]
35	#   supersede  --id OLD plus the `new` flags (decision, rationale, alternatives required)
36	#   import     --from PENDING [--rewrite PATH ...]                   (main checkout only)
37	#   list       [--status S,..] [--voice V,..] [--decided-by V,..] [--not-decided-by V,..]
38	#              [--cycle C] [--since ISO] [--source-prefix P] [--source-epic SLUG] [--id ID ...]
39	#              [--format tsv|md|json]                               (read-only)
40	#   context    [--why] [--prd PATH] | --set-unattended --reason R | --clear --recorded-by decisions-command
41	# Common: --file PATH (target override), --quiet
42	# Exit: 0 ok; 1 refused (preflight, CI/hook context, lock busy, verify, validation, unknown id,
43	#       illegal transition, ref grammar, missing artifact, ambiguous confirm); 2 usage.
44	# =============================================================================
45	export LC_ALL=C
46	set -euo pipefail
47	
48	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
49	PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "${SCRIPT_DIR}/../../.." && pwd -P)"
50	G="${PROJECT_ROOT}/grimoires/loa"
51	LIVE="${G}/decisions.yaml"
52	VALIDATOR="${PROJECT_ROOT}/.claude/scripts/validate-artifact.sh"
53	OPERATOR_CMD="decisions-command"
54	QUIET=0
55	TMPF=""
56	MKLOCK=""
57	SCRATCH=""
58	# shellcheck source=/dev/null
59	source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/../compat-lib.sh"
60	
61	release_mklock(){ [[ -n "$MKLOCK" ]] || return 0; rm -f "${MKLOCK}/pid" 2>/dev/null; rmdir "$MKLOCK" 2>/dev/null; MKLOCK=""; return 0; }
62	cleanup(){ [[ -n "$TMPF" ]] && rm -f "$TMPF" 2>/dev/null; [[ -n "$SCRATCH" ]] && rm -f "$SCRATCH".old "$SCRATCH".new "$SCRATCH" 2>/dev/null; release_mklock; return 0; }
63	trap cleanup EXIT
64	
65	log(){ [[ $QUIET -eq 0 ]] && echo "$@" >&2 || true; }
66	warn(){ echo "dec-write: WARN: $*" >&2; }
67	die(){ echo "dec-write: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
68	usage(){ echo "dec-write: usage: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
69	
70	# Single-line scalar, identical to kf-write-lib.sh san1(): strip control bytes, C1 controls and
71	# U+2028/U+2029 (as their UTF-8 bytes under LC_ALL=C), flatten whitespace, trim.
72	DEC_ULB_RE="$(printf '\302[\200-\237]|\342\200[\250\251]')"
73	san1(){ printf '%s' "${1-}" | tr -d '\000-\010\013\014\016-\037\177' | tr '\t\n\r' '   ' | sed -E "s/${DEC_ULB_RE}/ /g"' ; s/  +/ /g; s/^ //; s/ $//'; }
74	
75	# ---- arg parsing (bash 3.2 safe: no associative arrays; values stored as O_<key>) ----
76	BOOL_KEYS=" quiet all pending why set-unattended clear "
77	MULTI_KEYS=" id alternative-json consequence-pos consequence-neg rewrite prior-request "
78	KNOWN_KEYS=" file summary phase category recorded-by source status decision rationale answer-ref as cycle evidence sprint follow-up from format voice decided-by not-decided-by since source-prefix source-epic reason prd "
79	US=$'\037'
80	o(){ local n="O_${1//-/_}"; printf '%s' "${!n-}"; }
81	has(){ local n="O_${1//-/_}"; [[ -n "${!n+x}" ]]; }
82	# Print each value of a repeatable flag as a NUL-terminated record.
83	om(){
84	  local n="O_${1//-/_}" v rest
85	  [[ -n "${!n+x}" ]] || return 0
86	  v="${!n}"
87	  while :; do
88	    if [[ "$v" == *"$US"* ]]; then printf '%s\0' "${v%%"$US"*}"; v="${v#*"$US"}"; else printf '%s\0' "$v"; break; fi
89	  done
90	}
91	CMD="${1:-}"; [[ $# -gt 0 ]] && shift || true
92	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
93	  case "$1" in
94	    --*)
95	      k="${1#--}"; shift
96	      [[ "$k" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$ ]] || usage "bad flag --$k"
97	      if [[ "$BOOL_KEYS" == *" $k "* ]]; then printf -v "O_${k//-/_}" '%s' 1; continue; fi
98	      [[ "$MULTI_KEYS" == *" $k "* || "$KNOWN_KEYS" == *" $k "* ]] || usage "unknown flag --$k (see --help)"
99	      [[ $# -gt 0 ]] || usage "--$k needs a value"
100	      v="$1"; shift
101	      if [[ "$MULTI_KEYS" == *" $k "* ]]; then
102	        n="O_${k//-/_}"
103	        if [[ -n "${!n+x}" ]]; then printf -v "$n" '%s' "${!n}${US}${v}"; else printf -v "$n" '%s' "$v"; fi
104	      else
105	        printf -v "O_${k//-/_}" '%s' "$v"
106	      fi ;;
107	    *) usage "unexpected argument: $1" ;;
108	  esac
109	done
110	has quiet && QUIET=1
111	
112	# ---- environment -------------------------------------------------------------
113	session_id(){ local s="${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:-${CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID:-}}"; s="$(printf '%s' "$s" | tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9_.-')"; printf '%s' "${s:-unknown-session}"; }
114	now_utc(){ date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ; }
115	
116	abs_dir(){ (cd "$1" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P); }
117	# Main checkout root when PROJECT_ROOT is a linked worktree; empty otherwise.
118	MAIN_ROOT=""
119	IS_WORKTREE=0
120	detect_worktree(){
121	  command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0
122	  local gd cd
123	  gd="$(cd "$PROJECT_ROOT" && git rev-parse --git-dir 2>/dev/null)" || return 0
124	  cd="$(cd "$PROJECT_ROOT" && git rev-parse --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)" || return 0
125	  gd="$(cd "$PROJECT_ROOT" && abs_dir "$gd")"; cd="$(cd "$PROJECT_ROOT" && abs_dir "$cd")"
126	  if [[ -n "$gd" && -n "$cd" && "$gd" != "$cd" ]]; then
127	    IS_WORKTREE=1
128	    MAIN_ROOT="$(dirname "$cd")"
129	  fi
130	  return 0
131	}
132	detect_worktree
133	
134	# Run-state directories: this checkout's .run, plus the main checkout's when this is a worktree.
135	run_dirs(){ printf '%s\n' "${PROJECT_ROOT}/.run"; [[ -n "$MAIN_ROOT" ]] && printf '%s\n' "${MAIN_ROOT}/.run"; return 0; }
136	
137	ttl_hours(){
138	  local t="" cfg="${PROJECT_ROOT}/.loa.config.yaml"
139	  if [[ -f "$cfg" ]] && command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
140	    t="$(yq '.decisions.unattended_marker_ttl_hours // ""' "$cfg" 2>/dev/null || true)"
141	  fi
142	  [[ "$t" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$t" -gt 0 ]] || t=24
143	  printf '%s' "$t"
144	}
145	
146	# fresh | stale | absent for one marker file.
147	marker_state(){
148	  local f="$1" sid ca ep now sess
149	  [[ -f "$f" ]] || { echo absent; return 0; }
150	  sid="$(jq -r '.session_id // empty' "$f" 2>/dev/null || true)"
151	  ca="$(jq -r '.created_at // empty' "$f" 2>/dev/null || true)"
152	  [[ -n "$ca" ]] || { echo stale; return 0; }
153	  ep="$(_date_to_epoch "$ca" 2>/dev/null || true)"
154	  [[ "$ep" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || { echo stale; return 0; }
155	  now="$(date -u +%s)"
156	  if (( now - ep > $(ttl_hours) * 3600 )); then echo stale; return 0; fi
157	  sess="${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:-${CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID:-}}"
158	  if [[ -n "$sess" && -n "$sid" && "$sid" != "$sess" ]]; then echo stale; return 0; fi
159	  echo fresh
160	}
161	
162	PRD_PATH=""
163	# Print one line per active unattended signal: "<kind> <detail>"; kind live|prd.
164	ctx_signals(){
165	  local d f st
166	  while IFS= read -r d; do
167	    [[ -n "$d" ]] || continue
168	    if [[ "$(marker_state "$d/unattended.json")" == "fresh" ]]; then echo "live unattended-marker:${d}/unattended.json"; fi
169	    for f in "$d/sprint-plan-state.json" "$d/state.json"; do
170	      [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
171	      st="$(jq -r '.state // empty' "$f" 2>/dev/null || true)"
172	      if [[ "$st" == "RUNNING" ]]; then echo "live run-state:${f}"; fi
173	    done
174	  done < <(run_dirs)
175	  if [[ "${LOA_UNATTENDED:-}" == "1" ]]; then echo "live env:LOA_UNATTENDED=1"; fi
176	  if [[ "${LOA_FLATLINE_MODE:-}" == "autonomous" ]]; then echo "live env:LOA_FLATLINE_MODE=autonomous"; fi
177	  local prd="${PRD_PATH:-${G}/prd.md}"
178	  if [[ -f "$prd" ]] && grep -m1 -E '^\*\*Status:?\*\*:?' "$prd" 2>/dev/null | grep -qiE 'autonomous|unattended'; then
179	    echo "prd prd-status:${prd}"
180	  fi
181	  return 0
182	}
183	is_unattended(){ [[ -n "$(ctx_signals)" ]]; }
184	live_run_signal(){ ctx_signals | grep -q '^live ' ; }
185	
186	ci_blocked(){
187	  if [[ -n "${CI:-}" && "${CI}" != "false" && "${CI}" != "0" ]]; then echo "CI"; return 0; fi
188	  if [[ -n "${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-}" ]]; then echo "GITHUB_ACTIONS"; return 0; fi
189	  if [[ "${LOA_HOOK_CONTEXT:-}" == "1" ]]; then echo "LOA_HOOK_CONTEXT"; return 0; fi
190	  return 1
191	}
192	
193	preflight(){
194	  command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "preflight: jq is required (install jq 1.6+); nothing written"
195	  command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "preflight: Mike Farah yq v4 is required (https://github.com/mikefarah/yq, e.g. brew install yq); nothing written"
196	  local v; v="$(yq --version 2>&1 || true)"
197	  [[ "$v" == *mikefarah* && "$v" == *"version v4."* ]] || die "preflight: yq is not Mike Farah yq v4 (found: $(san1 "$v")); install https://github.com/mikefarah/yq v4; nothing written"
198	}
199	
200	# ---- lock (flock -w when present, else a mkdir lock with a stale check) ------
201	LOCK_WAIT="${LOA_DEC_LOCK_WAIT:-10}"
202	[[ "$LOCK_WAIT" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$LOCK_WAIT" -ge 1 && "$LOCK_WAIT" -le 10 ]] || LOCK_WAIT=10
203	lock_path(){ # target -> lock file under .run, keyed by the target's absolute path
204	  local abs h
205	  abs="$(abs_dir "$(dirname "$1")")/$(basename "$1")"
206	  h="$(printf '%s' "$abs" | sha256_portable | cut -c1-12)"
207	  printf '%s' "${PROJECT_ROOT}/.run/.dec-write-${h}.lock"
208	}
209	acquire_lock(){ # target
210	  local lp; lp="$(lock_path "$1")"
211	  mkdir -p "${PROJECT_ROOT}/.run"
212	  if command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1 && [[ "${LOA_DEC_NO_FLOCK:-0}" != "1" ]]; then
213	    exec 9>"$lp"
214	    flock -w "$LOCK_WAIT" 9 || die "lock busy: another writer holds ${lp} (waited ${LOCK_WAIT}s); retry"
215	    return 0
216	  fi
217	  local d="${lp}.d" tries=$(( LOCK_WAIT * 10 )) pid
218	  while ! mkdir "$d" 2>/dev/null; do
219	    pid="$(cat "$d/pid" 2>/dev/null || true)"
220	    # Stale: older than 60 s and its owner is gone.
221	    if [[ -n "$(find "$d" -maxdepth 0 -mmin +1 2>/dev/null)" ]] && { [[ -z "$pid" ]] || ! kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; }; then
222	      rm -f "$d/pid" 2>/dev/null; rmdir "$d" 2>/dev/null || true; continue
223	    fi
224	    tries=$(( tries - 1 ))
225	    (( tries > 0 )) || die "lock busy: another writer holds ${d} (waited ${LOCK_WAIT}s); retry"
226	    sleep 0.1
227	  done
228	  MKLOCK="$d"
229	  printf '%s\n' "$$" > "$d/pid"
230	}
231	
232	# ---- target resolution -------------------------------------------------------
233	TARGET=""
234	TARGET_KIND=""   # fixture | live | pending
235	pending_path(){
236	  local n="" st
237	  n="$(san1 "$(o sprint)")"
238	  if [[ -z "$n" ]]; then
239	    for st in "${PROJECT_ROOT}/.run/sprint-plan-state.json" ${MAIN_ROOT:+"${MAIN_ROOT}/.run/sprint-plan-state.json"}; do
240	      [[ -f "$st" ]] || continue
241	      n="$(jq -r '(.sprints.current // "") as $c | ([.sprints.list[]? | select(.id == $c) | .global_id] | first) // $c // empty' "$st" 2>/dev/null || true)"
242	      [[ -n "$n" ]] && break
243	    done
244	  fi
245	  n="${n#sprint-}"
246	  if [[ ! "$n" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$ ]]; then warn "no sprint number (pass --sprint N); writing the pending file under sprint-unknown"; n="unknown"; fi
247	  printf '%s' "${G}/a2a/sprint-${n}/decisions-pending.yaml"
248	}
249	resolve_target(){ # mode: write|read
250	  if has file; then
251	    TARGET="$(o file)"; TARGET_KIND="fixture"
252	    [[ -f "$TARGET" ]] || die "target not found: ${TARGET}"
253	    return 0
254	  fi
255	  if [[ "$1" == "write" ]] && { has pending || [[ $IS_WORKTREE -eq 1 ]]; }; then
256	    TARGET="$(pending_path)"; TARGET_KIND="pending"
257	  else
258	    TARGET="$LIVE"; TARGET_KIND="live"
259	  fi
260	  if [[ "$1" == "write" ]]; then

#              [--as flatline|dissent] [--cycle C] [--evidence E] [--pending] [--sprint N]

#              [--answer-ref REF] [--consequence-pos X ...] [--consequence-neg X ...]
#   confirm    --recorded-by decisions-command --evidence E (--id ID ... | --cycle C [--all])

# ---- arg parsing (bash 3.2 safe: no associative arrays; values stored as O_<key>) ----
BOOL_KEYS=" quiet all pending why set-unattended clear "
MULTI_KEYS=" id alternative-json consequence-pos consequence-neg rewrite prior-request "
KNOWN_KEYS=" file summary phase category recorded-by source status decision rationale answer-ref as cycle evidence sprint follow-up from format voice decided-by not-decided-by since source-prefix source-epic reason prd "
US=$'\037'
o(){ local n="O_${1//-/_}"; printf '%s' "${!n-}"; }
has(){ local n="O_${1//-/_}"; [[ -n "${!n+x}" ]]; }
# Print each value of a repeatable flag as a NUL-terminated record.
om(){
  local n="O_${1//-/_}" v rest
  [[ -n "${!n+x}" ]] || return 0
  v="${!n}"
  while :; do
    if [[ "$v" == *"$US"* ]]; then printf '%s\0' "${v%%"$US"*}"; v="${v#*"$US"}"; else printf '%s\0' "$v"; break; fi
  done
}
CMD="${1:-}"; [[ $# -gt 0 ]] && shift || true
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    --*)
      k="${1#--}"; shift
      [[ "$k" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$ ]] || usage "bad flag --$k"
      if [[ "$BOOL_KEYS" == *" $k "* ]]; then printf -v "O_${k//-/_}" '%s' 1; continue; fi
      [[ "$MULTI_KEYS" == *" $k "* || "$KNOWN_KEYS" == *" $k "* ]] || usage "unknown flag --$k (see --help)"
      [[ $# -gt 0 ]] || usage "--$k needs a value"
      v="$1"; shift
      if [[ "$MULTI_KEYS" == *" $k "* ]]; then
        n="O_${k//-/_}"
        if [[ -n "${!n+x}" ]]; then printf -v "$n" '%s' "${!n}${US}${v}"; else printf -v "$n" '%s' "$v"; fi
      else
        printf -v "O_${k//-/_}" '%s' "$v"
      fi ;;
    *) usage "unexpected argument: $1" ;;
  esac
done

abs_dir(){ (cd "$1" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P); }
# Main checkout root when PROJECT_ROOT is a linked worktree; empty otherwise.
MAIN_ROOT=""
IS_WORKTREE=0
detect_worktree(){
  command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0
  local gd cd
  gd="$(cd "$PROJECT_ROOT" && git rev-parse --git-dir 2>/dev/null)" || return 0
  cd="$(cd "$PROJECT_ROOT" && git rev-parse --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)" || return 0
  gd="$(cd "$PROJECT_ROOT" && abs_dir "$gd")"; cd="$(cd "$PROJECT_ROOT" && abs_dir "$cd")"
  if [[ -n "$gd" && -n "$cd" && "$gd" != "$cd" ]]; then
    IS_WORKTREE=1
    MAIN_ROOT="$(dirname "$cd")"
  fi
  return 0
}

# Run-state directories: this checkout's .run, plus the main checkout's when this is a worktree.

ttl_hours(){
  local t="" cfg="${PROJECT_ROOT}/.loa.config.yaml"
  if [[ -f "$cfg" ]] && command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    t="$(yq '.decisions.unattended_marker_ttl_hours // ""' "$cfg" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  fi
  [[ "$t" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$t" -gt 0 ]] || t=24
  printf '%s' "$t"
}

# fresh | stale | absent for one marker file.
marker_state(){
  local f="$1" sid ca ep now sess
  [[ -f "$f" ]] || { echo absent; return 0; }
  sid="$(jq -r '.session_id // empty' "$f" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  ca="$(jq -r '.created_at // empty' "$f" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  [[ -n "$ca" ]] || { echo stale; return 0; }
  ep="$(_date_to_epoch "$ca" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  [[ "$ep" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || { echo stale; return 0; }
  now="$(date -u +%s)"
  if (( now - ep > $(ttl_hours) * 3600 )); then echo stale; return 0; fi
  sess="${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:-${CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID:-}}"
  if [[ -n "$sess" && -n "$sid" && "$sid" != "$sess" ]]; then echo stale; return 0; fi
  echo fresh
}

# Print one line per active unattended signal: "<kind> <detail>"; kind live|prd.
ctx_signals(){
  local d f st
  while IFS= read -r d; do
    [[ -n "$d" ]] || continue
    if [[ "$(marker_state "$d/unattended.json")" == "fresh" ]]; then echo "live unattended-marker:${d}/unattended.json"; fi
    for f in "$d/sprint-plan-state.json" "$d/state.json"; do
      [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
      st="$(jq -r '.state // empty' "$f" 2>/dev/null || true)"
      if [[ "$st" == "RUNNING" ]]; then echo "live run-state:${f}"; fi
    done
  done < <(run_dirs)
  if [[ "${LOA_UNATTENDED:-}" == "1" ]]; then echo "live env:LOA_UNATTENDED=1"; fi
  if [[ "${LOA_FLATLINE_MODE:-}" == "autonomous" ]]; then echo "live env:LOA_FLATLINE_MODE=autonomous"; fi

  if [[ -f "$prd" ]] && grep -m1 -E '^\*\*Status:?\*\*:?' "$prd" 2>/dev/null | grep -qiE 'autonomous|unattended'; then
    echo "prd prd-status:${prd}"
  fi
  return 0
}

  return 1
}

# ---- lock (flock -w when present, else a mkdir lock with a stale check) ------
LOCK_WAIT="${LOA_DEC_LOCK_WAIT:-10}"
[[ "$LOCK_WAIT" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$LOCK_WAIT" -ge 1 && "$LOCK_WAIT" -le 10 ]] || LOCK_WAIT=10
lock_path(){ # target -> lock file under .run, keyed by the target's absolute path
  local abs h
  abs="$(abs_dir "$(dirname "$1")")/$(basename "$1")"
  h="$(printf '%s' "$abs" | sha256_portable | cut -c1-12)"
  printf '%s' "${PROJECT_ROOT}/.run/.dec-write-${h}.lock"
}
acquire_lock(){ # target
  local lp; lp="$(lock_path "$1")"
  mkdir -p "${PROJECT_ROOT}/.run"
  if command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1 && [[ "${LOA_DEC_NO_FLOCK:-0}" != "1" ]]; then
    exec 9>"$lp"
    flock -w "$LOCK_WAIT" 9 || die "lock busy: another writer holds ${lp} (waited ${LOCK_WAIT}s); retry"
    return 0
  fi
  local d="${lp}.d" tries=$(( LOCK_WAIT * 10 )) pid
  while ! mkdir "$d" 2>/dev/null; do
    pid="$(cat "$d/pid" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    # Stale: older than 60 s and its owner is gone.
    if [[ -n "$(find "$d" -maxdepth 0 -mmin +1 2>/dev/null)" ]] && { [[ -z "$pid" ]] || ! kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; }; then
      rm -f "$d/pid" 2>/dev/null; rmdir "$d" 2>/dev/null || true; continue
    fi
    tries=$(( tries - 1 ))
    (( tries > 0 )) || die "lock busy: another writer holds ${d} (waited ${LOCK_WAIT}s); retry"
    sleep 0.1
  done
  MKLOCK="$d"
  printf '%s\n' "$$" > "$d/pid"
}

file.content:
if [[ "$1" == "write" ]]; then
    local why; if why="$(ci_blocked)"; then die "refused: ${why} is set; the ledger is never written from CI or a hook (use --file <fixture> in tests)"; fi
    if [[ "$TARGET_KIND" == "pending" && ! -f "$TARGET" ]]; then
      mkdir -p "$(dirname "$TARGET")"
      cat > "$TARGET" <<'EOF_PEND'
# decisions-pending.yaml: provisional decision rows (PEND-<8 hex> ids) written outside the main checkout.
# The lead imports them in the main checkout: .claude/scripts/lib/dec-write-lib.sh import --from <this file>
schema_version: 1
decisions: []
EOF_PEND
    fi
    [[ -f "$TARGET" ]] || die "ledger not found: ${TARGET} (restore the tracked grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml)"
  fi
  return 0
}

# JSON view of a ledger file; dies unless schema_version 1 and .decisions a sequence.
read_ledger(){
  local j
  j="$(yq -o=json -I0 '.' "$1" 2>/dev/null)" || die "unparsable ledger: $1"
  printf '%s' "$j" | jq -e '(.schema_version == 1) and ((.decisions // null) | type == "array")' >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    || die "ledger $1 has an unknown schema_version or no decisions sequence; refusing to write"
  printf '%s' "$j"
}

# ---- refs, voices, artifacts ---------------------------------------------------
REF_RE='^(session:[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+#turn-[0-9]+|debrief:[^#[:space:]]+#[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+|transcript:[^#[:space:]]+#L[0-9]+|cli:[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(:[0-9]{2})?(\.[0-9]+)?(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:?[0-9]{2})|flatline:[^[:space:]]+|dissent:[^[:space:]]+)$'
OPREF_RE='^(session|debrief|transcript|cli):'
# Resolve an artifact path from a flatline:/dissent: ref; prints the absolute path or dies.
artifact_path(){ # voice path
  local voice="$1" p="$2" a
  [[ "$p" != *".."* ]] || die "artifact path may not contain '..': $p"
  if [[ "$p" == /* ]]; then a="$p"; else a="${PROJECT_ROOT}/${p}"; fi
  [[ -f "$a" ]] || die "--as ${voice}: artifact not found: $p"
  a="$(abs_dir "$(dirname "$a")")/$(basename "$a")"
  case "$a" in "${PROJECT_ROOT}/"*) ;; *) die "--as ${voice}: artifact must live inside the project: $p" ;; esac
  local rel="${a#"${PROJECT_ROOT}/"}"
  if [[ "$voice" == "flatline" ]]; then
    [[ "$rel" =~ ^\.flatline/runs/[^/]+\.json$ ]] || die "--as flatline: the artifact must be .flatline/runs/<run>.json (got $rel)"
    jq -e 'has("phase")' "$a" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "--as flatline: $rel is not a Flatline run record (no .phase)"
  else
    [[ "$rel" =~ ^grimoires/loa/a2a/(.+/)?adversarial-[^/]*\.json$ ]] || die "--as dissent: the artifact must be grimoires/loa/a2a/**/adversarial-*.json (got $rel)"
    jq -e '.' "$a" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "--as dissent: $rel is not valid JSON"
  fi
  printf '%s' "$a"
}

# Sets VOICE, REF, SHA from --as / --answer-ref and the context. $1 = allow_as (1 at creation).
VOICE="agent"; REF=""; SHA=""
derive_attribution(){
  local allow_as="$1" as ref
  as="$(san1 "$(o as)")"; ref="$(san1 "$(o answer-ref)")"
  VOICE="agent"; REF=""; SHA=""
  if is_unattended; then
    [[ -z "$ref" ]] || warn "unattended context: --answer-ref ignored (the row stays proposed with proposed_by agent until /decisions confirm)"
    [[ -z "$as" ]] || warn "unattended context: --as ${as} ignored"
    return 0
  fi
  if [[ -n "$as" ]]; then
    [[ "$allow_as" == "1" ]] || die "--as is set once, at creation (proposed_by is immutable)"
    [[ "$as" == "flatline" || "$as" == "dissent" ]] || usage "--as must be flatline or dissent"
    [[ "$ref" == "${as}:"* ]] || die "--as ${as} needs --answer-ref ${as}:<artifact path>"
  fi
  if [[ -n "$ref" ]]; then
    [[ "$ref" =~ $REF_RE ]] || die "--answer-ref does not match the ref grammar (session:<id>#turn-<n> | debrief:<path>#<anchor> | transcript:<path>#L<n> | cli:<iso-8601> | flatline:<path> | dissent:<path>): $ref"
    if [[ "$ref" == flatline:* || "$ref" == dissent:* ]]; then
      local rv="${ref%%:*}" a
      [[ "$as" == "$rv" ]] || die "a ${rv}: ref needs --as ${rv}"
      a="$(artifact_path "$rv" "${ref#*:}")"
      SHA="$(sha256_portable "$a" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
      VOICE="$rv"
    fi
    REF="$ref"
  fi
  return 0
}

# ---- row parts -------------------------------------------------------------------
alts_json(){
  local a="[]" item op rb
  while IFS= read -r -d '' item; do
    printf '%s' "$item" | jq -e 'type == "object" and ((.option // null) | type == "string") and ((.rejected_because // null) | type == "string") and ((keys - ["option","rejected_because"]) | length == 0)' >/dev/null 2>&1 \
      || die "--alternative-json must be {\"option\":\"...\",\"rejected_because\":\"...\"}: $(san1 "$item")"
    op="$(san1 "$(printf '%s' "$item" | jq -r '.option')")"; rb="$(san1 "$(printf '%s' "$item" | jq -r '.rejected_because')")"
    [[ -n "$op" && -n "$rb" ]] || die "--alternative-json needs a non-empty option and rejected_because"
    a="$(jq -cn --argjson a "$a" --arg o "$op" --arg r "$rb" '$a + [{option: $o, rejected_because: $r}]')"
  done < <(om alternative-json)
  printf '%s' "$a"
}
str_list_json(){ local a="[]" item s; while IFS= read -r -d '' item; do s="$(san1 "$item")"; [[ -z "$s" ]] || a="$(jq -cn --argjson a "$a" --arg s "$s" '$a + [$s]')"; done < <(om "$1"); printf '%s' "$a"; }
cons_json(){ local p n; p="$(str_list_json consequence-pos)"; n="$(str_list_json consequence-neg)"
  jq -cn --argjson p "$p" --argjson n "$n" 'if ($p|length) == 0 and ($n|length) == 0 then null else {positive: $p, negative: $n} end'; }

recorded_by(){
  local r; r="$(o recorded-by)"
  [[ -n "$r" ]] || usage "--recorded-by <skill-or-command> is required"
  [[ "$r" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$ ]] || usage "--recorded-by must match [A-Za-z0-9_.-]+ (a skill or command name): $(san1 "$r")"
  printf '%s' "$r"
}
is_operator_call(){ [[ "$(o recorded-by)" == "$OPERATOR_CMD" ]]; }
head_commit(){ local c; c="$(cd "$PROJECT_ROOT" && git rev-parse --short=8 HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)"; if [[ "$c" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$ ]]; then printf '%s' "$c"; else printf 'unknown'; fi; }
default_cycle(){
  local c st
  for st in "${PROJECT_ROOT}/.run/sprint-plan-state.json" "${PROJECT_ROOT}/.run/state.json" ${MAIN_ROOT:+"${MAIN_ROOT}/.run/sprint-plan-state.json"}; do
    [[ -f "$st" ]] || continue
    c="$(jq -r '.cycle_id // .cycle // empty' "$st" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if [[ -n "$c" ]]; then printf '%s' "$c"; return 0; fi
  done
  for st in "${G}/ledger.json" ${MAIN_ROOT:+"${MAIN_ROOT}/grimoires/loa/ledger.json"}; do
    [[ -f "$st" ]] || continue
    c="$(jq -r '.active_cycle // empty' "$st" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if [[ -n "$c" ]]; then printf '%s' "$c"; return 0; fi
  done
  return 0
}

next_dec_id(){ # ledger-json
  printf '%s' "$1" | jq -r '[.decisions[].id | strings | select(test("^DEC-[0-9]+$")) | ltrimstr("DEC-") | tonumber] | (max // 0) + 1 | tostring | (if length < 4 then ("0000"[0:(4 - length)] + .) else . end) | "DEC-" + .'
}
pend_id(){ printf 'PEND-%s' "$(od -An -N4 -tx1 /dev/urandom | tr -d ' \n')"; }

# ---- temp / apply / verify -------------------------------------------------------
STYLE_ROW='(.decisions[] | select(.id == strenv(ROWID)) | ..) style="" | (.decisions[] | select(.id == strenv(ROWID)) | .. | select(tag == "!!str")) style="double" | (.decisions[] | select(.id == strenv(ROWID)) | .. | key) style=""'
begin_tmp(){ TMPF="$(mktemp "${TARGET}.XXXXXX")"; cp "$TARGET" "$TMPF"; }
append_row(){ # row-json
  local id; id="$(printf '%s' "$1" | jq -r '.id')"
  ROW="$1" ROWID="$id" yq -i ".decisions += [env(ROW)] | ${STYLE_ROW}" "$TMPF" || die "yq append failed; ledger untouched"
}
replace_row(){ # row-json
  local id; id="$(printf '%s' "$1" | jq -r '.id')"
  ROW="$1" ROWID="$id" yq -i "(.decisions[] | select(.id == strenv(ROWID))) = env(ROW) | ${STYLE_ROW}" "$TMPF" || die "yq update failed; ledger untouched"
}
# verify_and_swap OLD_JSON ADDED TOUCHED_IDS_JSON
verify_and_swap(){
  local old="$1" added="$2" touched="$3" errs
  # Whole-ledger JSON goes through files (--slurpfile): a large ledger overflows one argv string.
  SCRATCH="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/dec-verify.XXXXXX")"
  printf '%s' "$old" > "${SCRATCH}.old"
  yq -o=json -I0 '.' "$TMPF" > "${SCRATCH}.new" 2>/dev/null || die "ABORT: the candidate ledger does not parse; ledger untouched"
  errs="$(jq -rn --slurpfile O "${SCRATCH}.old" --slurpfile N "${SCRATCH}.new" --argjson added "$added" --argjson t "$touched" '
    $O[0] as $o | $N[0] as $n
    | ($o.decisions | map(.id)) as $oi | (($n.decisions // []) | map(.id)) as $ni
    | (($n.decisions // []) | map(select(type == "object" and (.id | type) == "string") | {key: .id, value: .}) | from_entries) as $nb
    | ($oi | map({key: ., value: true}) | from_entries) as $os | ($t | map({key: ., value: true}) | from_entries) as $ts
    | [ (if $n.schema_version != 1 then "unknown schema_version" else empty end),
        (if ($n.decisions | type) != "array" then "decisions is not a sequence" else empty end),
        ($oi - $ni | .[] | "would drop id \(.)"),
        ($ni | group_by(.) | map(select(length > 1) | .[0]) | .[] | "duplicate id \(.)"),
        (if ($ni | length) != (($o.decisions | length) + $added) then "row count \($ni | length) != \($o.decisions | length) + \($added)" else empty end),
        ($o.decisions[] as $r | select($ts[$r.id] | not) | select($nb[$r.id] != $r) | "row \($r.id) changed outside this operation"),
        ($n.decisions[] | .id as $x | select($os[$x] | not) | select($ts[$x] | not) | "unexpected new row \($x)")
      ] | .[]')" || die "ABORT: verification failed to run; ledger untouched"
  [[ -z "$errs" ]] || die "ABORT: ${errs//$'\n'/; }; ledger untouched"
  [[ -f "$VALIDATOR" ]] || die "ABORT: validator missing at ${VALIDATOR}; ledger untouched"
  local vout
  if ! vout="$(PROJECT_ROOT="$PROJECT_ROOT" bash "$VALIDATOR" --type decisions --file "$TMPF" --base-file "$TARGET" 2>&1)"; then
    die "ABORT: the candidate fails validate-artifact.sh --type decisions; ledger untouched:"$'\n'"$vout"
  fi
  chmod 0644 "$TMPF"
  mv -f "$TMPF" "$TARGET"; TMPF=""
}
row_by_id(){ printf '%s' "$1" | jq -c --arg id "$2" '[.decisions[] | select(.id == $id)] | first // empty'; }

# ---- ops -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build a new row JSON. Args: id status voice ref sha supersedes
build_row(){
  local id="$1" status="$2" voice="$3" ref="$4" sha="$5" sup="$6"
  local summary phase category source decision rationale alts cons rb cyc now ev
  summary="$(san1 "$(o summary)")"; phase="$(san1 "$(o phase)")"; category="$(san1 "$(o category)")"; source="$(san1 "$(o source)")"
  [[ -n "$summary" ]] || usage "--summary is required"
  # characters, not bytes (LC_ALL=C makes ${#x} a byte count): the validator's limit is 160 code points
  [[ "$(jq -rn --arg s "$summary" '$s | length')" -le 160 ]] || die "--summary is over 160 characters; one plain line"
  [[ "$phase" =~ ^(discovery|architecture|sprint-planning|implementation|review|charting|spike|operations)$ ]] || usage "--phase must be discovery|architecture|sprint-planning|implementation|review|charting|spike|operations"
  [[ "$category" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$ ]] || usage "--category must match [a-z][a-z0-9-]* (e.g. scope, technology, architecture)"
  [[ -n "$source" ]] || usage "--source is required (bead id, PR, NOTES anchor, spike path, with a line or anchor)"
  decision="$(san1 "$(o decision)")"; rationale="$(san1 "$(o rationale)")"; alts="$(alts_json)"; cons="$(cons_json)"
  if [[ "$status" == "proposed" ]]; then
    [[ -n "$decision" && -n "$rationale" && "$(printf '%s' "$alts" | jq 'length')" -ge 1 ]] \
      || die "a proposed row needs --decision, --rationale and at least one --alternative-json"
  fi
  rb="$(recorded_by)"; cyc="$(san1 "$(o cycle)")"; [[ -n "$cyc" ]] || cyc="$(default_cycle)"
  if [[ -z "$cyc" ]] && is_unattended; then warn "no cycle id (pass --cycle); the row's cycle is null"; fi
  now="$(now_utc)"; ev="$(san1 "$(o evidence)")"; [[ -n "$ev" ]] || ev="$source"
  jq -cn --arg id "$id" --arg now "$now" --arg phase "$phase" --arg category "$category" --arg summary "$summary" \
    --arg decision "$decision" --arg rationale "$rationale" --argjson alts "$alts" --argjson cons "$cons" \
    --arg voice "$voice" --arg ref "$ref" --arg sha "$sha" --arg rb "${rb}/$(session_id)" --arg by "${voice}:${rb}" \
    --arg commit "$(head_commit)" --arg source "$source" --arg cycle "$cyc" --arg sup "$sup" --arg status "$status" --arg ev "$ev" '
    def n: if . == "" then null else . end;
    {id: $id, created_at: $now, updated_at: $now, phase: $phase, category: $category, summary: $summary,
     decision: ($decision | n), rationale: ($rationale | n),
     alternatives_considered: (if ($alts | length) == 0 then null else $alts end), consequences: $cons,
     proposed_by: $voice, decided_by: null, decided_by_ref: ($ref | n), evidence_sha256: ($sha | n),
     recorded_by: $rb, commit: $commit, source: $source, cycle: ($cycle | n), supersedes: ($sup | n),
     supersede_proposed_by: null, status: $status,
     transitions: [{at: $now, from: null, to: $status, by: $by, evidence: $ev}],
     rejection_rationale: null, follow_up: null, prior_requests: []}'
}

alloc_id(){ # ledger-json
  if [[ "$TARGET_KIND" == "pending" ]]; then pend_id; else next_dec_id "$1"; fi
}

op_new(){
  preflight; resolve_target write
  local status; status="$(san1 "$(o status)")"
  [[ -z "$status" || "$status" == "open" || "$status" == "proposed" ]] || usage "--status must be open or proposed (a row reaches decided only through /decisions confirm)"
  derive_attribution 1
  if is_unattended; then [[ "$status" == "open" ]] || status="proposed"; else status="${status:-open}"; fi
  acquire_lock "$TARGET"
  local old id row; old="$(read_ledger "$TARGET")"
  id="$(alloc_id "$old")"
  row="$(build_row "$id" "$status" "$VOICE" "$REF" "$SHA" "")"
  begin_tmp; append_row "$row"
  verify_and_swap "$old" 1 "$(jq -cn --arg i "$id" '[$i]')"
  log "dec-write: appended ${id} (${status}) to ${TARGET#"${PROJECT_ROOT}/"}"
  echo "$id"
}

need_id(){ local id; id="$(san1 "$(o id)")"; [[ "$id" =~ ^(DEC-[0-9]{4,}|PEND-[0-9a-f]{8})$ ]] || usage "--id DEC-NNNN (or PEND-<8 hex>) required"; printf '%s' "$id"; }

op_decide(){
  preflight
  local id; id="$(need_id)"
  [[ -n "$(san1 "$(o evidence)")" ]] || die "decide: --evidence is required (what the decision rests on)"
  resolve_target write
  derive_attribution 0
  acquire_lock "$TARGET"
  local old r; old="$(read_ledger "$TARGET")"; r="$(row_by_id "$old" "$id")"
  [[ -n "$r" ]] || die "decide: unknown id ${id}"
  [[ "$(printf '%s' "$r" | jq -r '.status')" == "open" ]] || die "decide: ${id} is $(printf '%s' "$r" | jq -r '.status'), not open (illegal transition)"
  local decision rationale alts cons rb now
  decision="$(san1 "$(o decision)")"; rationale="$(san1 "$(o rationale)")"; alts="$(alts_json)"; cons="$(cons_json)"
  [[ -n "$decision" && -n "$rationale" && "$(printf '%s' "$alts" | jq 'length')" -ge 1 ]] || die "decide: --decision, --rationale and at least one --alternative-json are required"
  rb="$(recorded_by)"; now="$(now_utc)"
  r="$(printf '%s' "$r" | jq -c --arg d "$decision" --arg w "$rationale" --argjson a "$alts" --argjson c "$cons" --arg ref "$REF" \
      --arg now "$now" --arg by "$(printf '%s' "$r" | jq -r '.proposed_by'):${rb}" --arg ev "$(san1 "$(o evidence)")" '
      .decision = $d | .rationale = $w | .alternatives_considered = $a
      | .consequences = (if .consequences == null then $c else .consequences end)
      | .decided_by_ref = (if .decided_by_ref == null and $ref != "" then $ref else .decided_by_ref end)
      | .status = "proposed" | .updated_at = $now
      | .transitions += [{at: $now, from: "open", to: "proposed", by: $by, evidence: $ev}]')"
  begin_tmp; replace_row "$r"
  verify_and_swap "$old" 0 "$(jq -cn --arg i "$id" '[$i]')"
  log "dec-write: ${id} open -> proposed"
}

op_confirm(){
  preflight
  is_operator_call || die "confirm runs only from the operator-only /decisions command (--recorded-by ${OPERATOR_CMD})"
  if live_run_signal; then die "confirm refused: a live-run signal holds ($(ctx_signals | grep '^live ' | cut -d' ' -f2 | paste -sd, -)); confirm after the run, interactively"; fi

if live_run_signal; then die "confirm refused: a live-run signal holds ($(ctx_signals | grep '^live ' | cut -d' ' -f2 | paste -sd, -)); confirm after the run, interactively"; fi
  local ev; ev="$(san1 "$(o evidence)")"; [[ -n "$ev" ]] || die "confirm: --evidence is required (e.g. cli:<iso-8601>)"
  resolve_target write
  [[ "$TARGET_KIND" != "pending" ]] || die "confirm runs on the live ledger in the main checkout, never on a pending file"
  derive_attribution 0
  acquire_lock "$TARGET"
  local old id cyc; old="$(read_ledger "$TARGET")"
  local -a ids=()
  while IFS= read -r -d '' id; do id="$(san1 "$id")"; [[ "$id" =~ ^DEC-[0-9]{4,}$ ]] || usage "confirm: bad --id $id"; ids+=("$id"); done < <(om id)
  cyc="$(san1 "$(o cycle)")"
  if [[ ${#ids[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
    [[ -n "$cyc" ]] || usage "confirm needs --id DEC-NNNN ... or --cycle <cycle> [--all]"
    local matches; matches="$(printf '%s' "$old" | jq -r --arg c "$cyc" '.decisions[] | select(.status == "proposed" and .cycle == $c) | .id')"
    [[ -n "$matches" ]] || die "confirm: no proposed rows in cycle ${cyc}"
    if [[ "$(printf '%s\n' "$matches" | grep -c .)" -gt 1 ]] && ! has all; then
      echo "confirm --cycle ${cyc} matches these proposed rows:" >&2
      printf '%s' "$old" | jq -r --arg c "$cyc" '.decisions[] | select(.status == "proposed" and .cycle == $c) | "  \(.id) \(.summary)"' >&2
      die "confirm: more than one row matches; pass --all or explicit --id values"
    fi
    while IFS= read -r id; do [[ -z "$id" ]] || ids+=("$id"); done <<< "$matches"
  fi
  local touched="[]" r now sup so cur="$old"; now="$(now_utc)"
  begin_tmp
  for id in "${ids[@]}"; do
    r="$(row_by_id "$cur" "$id")"; [[ -n "$r" ]] || die "confirm: unknown id ${id}"
    [[ "$(printf '%s' "$r" | jq -r '.status')" == "proposed" ]] || die "confirm: ${id} is $(printf '%s' "$r" | jq -r '.status'), not proposed (illegal transition)"
    echo "confirming ${id}: $(printf '%s' "$r" | jq -r '.summary')" >&2
    r="$(printf '%s' "$r" | jq -c --arg ref "$REF" --arg now "$now" --arg by "operator:${OPERATOR_CMD}" --arg ev "$ev" --arg opre "$OPREF_RE" '
        .decided_by_ref = (if .decided_by_ref == null and $ref != "" then $ref else .decided_by_ref end)
        | .decided_by = (if ((.decided_by_ref // "") | test($opre)) then "operator" else .proposed_by end)
        | .status = "decided" | .updated_at = $now
        | .transitions += [{at: $now, from: "proposed", to: "decided", by: $by, evidence: $ev}]')"
    replace_row "$r"
    touched="$(jq -cn --argjson t "$touched" --arg i "$id" '$t + [$i]')"
    # An agent-proposed supersede: the old decided row moves to superseded when its replacement is confirmed.
    sup="$(printf '%s' "$r" | jq -r '.supersedes // empty')"
    if [[ -n "$sup" ]]; then
      so="$(row_by_id "$cur" "$sup")"
      if [[ -n "$so" ]] && [[ "$(printf '%s' "$so" | jq -r '.status + "|" + (.supersede_proposed_by // "")')" == "decided|${id}" ]]; then
        so="$(printf '%s' "$so" | jq -c --arg now "$now" --arg by "operator:${OPERATOR_CMD}" --arg ev "$ev" --arg n "$id" '
            .status = "superseded" | .updated_at = $now | .transitions += [{at: $now, from: "decided", to: "superseded", by: $by, evidence: ("superseded by " + $n + "; " + $ev)}]')"
        replace_row "$so"
        touched="$(jq -cn --argjson t "$touched" --arg i "$sup" '$t + [$i]')"
      fi
    fi
    cur="$(yq -o=json -I0 '.' "$TMPF")"
  done
  verify_and_swap "$old" 0 "$touched"
  log "dec-write: confirmed ${ids[*]}"
}

  local from; from="$(o from)"; [[ -n "$from" ]] || usage "import --from <pending file> required"
